mixedContent.description: A production-shaped arbitrary React Native child containing an image, nested text, a badge, and a composed chart.

baseline.description: Same screen and child hierarchy with native marquee motion disabled.

static.description: Short content that fits the viewport; verifies that stationary marquees schedule no frames.

active.description: Production-shaped children moving continuously at 25 points per second.

updates.description: Alternates width-stable and width-changing values every 100 ms while moving.

gesture.description: Active marquees inside a vertically scrolling/recycling list while repeated swipe gestures run.

stress.description: Worst-case mounted count; the example must only animate visible, attached rows.
